name: known-gap-adtech-exclude-cannot-fire
reason: ROUTING FIXED BY MIGRATION 021, VOCABULARY STILL MISSING. The 'adtech' hard exclude does not fire on an adtech JD. It used to be a routing gap: the dealbreaker branch read a closed domain enum with no adtech value, and the industry survived only in screening_summary.industry, which that branch never read. The enum is gone and the branch reads the industry now -- so the remaining failure is purely lexical. The industry string is 'programmatic advertising technology, demand-side platform', and matchesSignal needs a contiguous whole-word run: 'adtech' is not one inside it, in either direction. This is the same class of miss as REST against 'RESTful APIs', which tags solved with an aliases column. Preference labels have no such column, and that is now what #48 is about for this fixture -- not routing. database/sample/README.md still claims this fixture 'fails the gate outright on the adtech hard exclude'; it does not.
